welcome: Getting to know Jesus and sharing his good news. Come and see what church is like.
firstVisit: If you’re new to church or just curious about Jesus, you’re welcome to come with questions.
doorsDescription: Coffee will be ready when you arrive. Come in, have a coffee on us and find a seat before we start.
serviceDescription: We’ll sing, pray and hear a talk from the Bible. You can listen or join in. The service lasts about 90 minutes.
ministriesIntro: There’s room for the whole family. Here’s what we’re exploring for Sundays and through the week.
